Now your `tasks.json` file is in the correct location at `.vscode/tasks.json`. This is the standard location where Cursor (and VS Code) will look for task configurations. The tasks you've defined (Start Expo, Start Backend, and Start Dev) will now be properly recognized by Cursor.

The `.vscode` directory is the standard location for VS Code/Cursor workspace settings and configurations. This is where you should also place other configuration files like:
- `settings.json` for workspace-specific settings
- `launch.json` for debug configurations
- `extensions.json` for recommended extensions

Your tasks will now be available in Cursor's command palette (Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + P) under "Tasks: Run Task".
